proved_scope: Critical beta=3 follows from ordinary first route-length moment under JM: exact finite mean per dyadic road-size band, finite number of bands per bounded window almost surely, infinite mean full cutoff traffic but all moments below one. Together with turn 1 covers 2<beta<=3.
